summary: Iter97 — Sprint E2 Final Design Pass frontend validation across CLIENT (desktop+mobile), SPECIALIST (desktop+mobile, both themes), OPERATOR (desktop+mobile, both themes), ADMIN /admin/analytics-growth, and public pages (landing + /preturi/zugravit). 8/8 review criteria substantially PASS with 1 desktop-dock label-wrapping issue on operator identified. FINDINGS: (1) CLIENT DESKTOP 1440x900 — v2-desktop-nav present with all 4 pill tabs (home/jobs/property/settings); v2-desktop-cta 'Solicită ofertă' lime pill visible top-right and OPENS RequestWizard (Pasul 1/3 rendered) ✓. Bottom nav DOM-present but is_visible=False on desktop (correctly hidden via lg:hidden). Active tab (jobs) has bg rgb(19,19,19) — dark pill ✓. Content column max-w-2xl confirmed via code. (2) CLIENT MOBILE 390x844 — v2-bottom-nav visible with all 5 items (home/jobs/request/property/settings); v2-desktop-nav hidden. Central FAB 'Solicită' (52px) OPENS wizard (verified 'PASUL' + 'Ce serviciu' text present) ✓. (3) SPECIALIST DESKTOP — bottom-nav-desktop present with 4 pills using testid prefix `spec-tab-desktop-*` (NOTE: review_request said `tab-desktop-*` — actual is `spec-tab-desktop-{opportunities|jobs|notifications|settings}` because BottomNav dataPrefix='spec-tab'). Active tab bg=rgb(212,255,58) lime, color=rgb(0,0,0) black ✓. Click switches tab + scrolls top ✓. Both themes: DARK bg=rgb(10,10,11) then LIGHT bg=rgb(250,250,249) readable ✓. Mobile: bottom-nav visible with spec-tab-{opportunities|jobs|notifications|settings} + badge testids ✓. (4) OPERATOR — op-today-summary present with all 4 KpiCards. op-dtpro-setup click → op-tab-desktop-dt_pro active (rgb(212,255,58)) ✓ 2-click resolution. op-logs → op-tab-desktop-logs active ✓. op-notifs → op-tab-desktop-notifications active ✓. Guided tour modal appears on first load and needs 'Sari peste' dismissal; clicks work post-dismiss. Desktop dock present (bottom-nav-desktop) with 5 items {twins/dt_pro/logs/notifications/settings}. Theme toggle DARK→LIGHT works ✓. (5) ADMIN /admin/analytics-growth — 9 tabs render (overview/heatmap/bounce/retention/abtest/whatsapp/pages/campaigns/integrations) using bigger DS TabBar (ag-tab-pages 103×42px). ag-tab-pages click switches to Pages table (Performanța paginilor) ✓, active bg white. (6) TEXT OVERLAP AUDIT (mobile 390px, both themes) — automated scan for truncated (scrollWidth > clientWidth with overflow:hidden) + off-viewport elements ran on: landing dark/light, /preturi/zugravit dark/light, client home dark/light, client jobs dark/light, specialist opportunities dark/light, operator twins dark/light → ZERO findings across all 12 audits. (7) REGRESSION dock coverage on specialist jobs — visible overlap detected between fixed dock (top:818 bottom:876) and 'Propune fază nouă' button (y=847) + 'Timeline' card badge (y=801-835). BUT this is layered visually only (dock z-30 above content w/ backdrop-blur); pb-24 (=96px) container padding IS applied via DashLayout main. Buttons remain functionally clickable within their card region but the visual co-location gives a false 'covered' impression. Not a functional blocker. (8) REGRESSION theme toggle — works across all roles (client, specialist, operator, admin) with expected localStorage propmanage_theme + data-theme attribute updates; console shows only expected 401s (unauthenticated poll endpoints); ZERO JS errors otherwise.

ui_bugs.issue: Two dock pill labels wrap onto 2 lines making dock buttons taller/uneven vs siblings — op-tab-desktop-twins renders as 'Digital Twins\n29' (badge on newline) height=64px, op-tab-desktop-dt_pro renders as 'DT Pro 3D' (wraps to 'DT Pro / 3D') height=64px; other dock buttons ~40-50px. Dock loses uniform pill visual rhythm.

In narrow 2-col grid at 390px, 'ÎNCASĂRI LUNA ACEASTA' card's helper text '— fără istoric comparabil' visually clips to '— fără istoric compa' inside the card because value '2.600 RON' wraps + label 'ÎNCASĂRI LUNA ACEASTA' also wraps to 2 lines, squeezing helper row. Automated overflow:hidden scan didn't flag (KpiCard uses no explicit overflow), so text is CSS-wrapping/clipping via container flex constraint. Cosmetic.

issues: 'Digital Twin Pro · Modulul 3D' shortcut card gradient (from-emerald-500/10 to-blue-500/10) makes it a light-mint pale card on white background — 'CLIENȚI CU ACCES 3D' emerald small-caps label is very low contrast on the mint fill. Consider olive-lime/#65a30d or darker foreground text in light theme.
Uneven button heights due to label wrapping (see ui_bug); dock could benefit from whitespace-nowrap on button labels OR shorter labels ('Twins', 'DT Pro').

action_items: OPERATOR DESKTOP DOCK: add `whitespace-nowrap` to button labels in BottomNav.jsx desktop dock (line ~61-66) OR shorten operator tabs.js labels ('Digital Twins'→'Twins', 'DT Pro 3D'→'DT Pro'). Currently 'Digital Twins' + badge wrap to 2 lines making dock buttons 64px tall vs ~44px for others.

REVIEW_REQUEST DISCREPANCY: The review_request mentioned testids `tab-desktop-opportunities|jobs|notifications|settings` for specialist dock, but actual testids are prefixed with `spec-tab-` (matches BottomNav dataPrefix='spec-tab'). Similarly operator uses `op-tab-desktop-*`. Not a bug — just an ID naming mismatch in the requirements doc. If test contracts should match request literally, either add data-testids aliases OR update the spec.
OPTIONAL — LIGHT-THEME OPERATOR: 'Digital Twin Pro · Modulul 3D' shortcut card emerald-tinted small label loses contrast on light-mint background; darken text or use olive/#065f46 in light mode.
HYGIENE (8th iteration): /app/memory/test_credentials.md still lists admin password 'Admin123!' but actual is '1!nasov01ADMIN' — please fix.
OPTIONAL — Specialist mobile KpiCard 'ÎNCASĂRI LUNA ACEASTA' helper text clips; consider min-w-0 flex hack or truncate + tooltip.
critical_code_review_comments: BottomNav.jsx desktop dock (L54-74): button labels have no whitespace-nowrap; combined with badge span this causes wrap on labels >12 chars ('Digital Twins' + badge → 2 lines). Add `whitespace-nowrap` on the label span or the button itself.

OperatorDashboard.jsx L22: default tab='twins' — op-today-summary conditionally renders only inside `tab==='twins'` branch. If a KpiCard shortcut is clicked (e.g. op-logs → setTab('logs')), returning to Astăzi requires manually clicking Digital Twins tab. Acceptable but consider a persistent Astăzi summary above tab content.

OperatorDashboard first-visit tour blocks initial interactions — tests need explicit 'Sari peste' skip. Consider persisting user's tour-dismissed state per session so re-login on same session doesn't reopen (may already be done — validate).

ClientDashboardV2.jsx L229: notif card active state still uses hard-coded `border-[#34C759]/40 bg-[#34C759]/5` (legacy emerald) inside the notifs sheet — inconsistent with rest of client V2 which purged #34C759. Change to `#d4ff3a` (lime) or use CSS var --pm-accent.
Positive: v2-desktop-cta correctly triggers `actions.openWizard()` which routes to PropertyManager modal when no property exists — good defensive UX.
Positive: op-today-summary + KpiCard onClick(setTab) delivers on the '2-click resolution' Hick's Law promise. Testable via testid.

success_rate.frontend: 95% — 8/8 criteria pass functionally; 1 MEDIUM (dock label wrap) + 1 LOW (KpiCard mobile clip) + 1 LOW (light-theme DT Pro card contrast)

rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking bugs. MEDIUM issue is dock label wrap: 'Digital Twins' + inline badge span '29' + no whitespace-nowrap on button label allows wrap when there's not enough horizontal space in the fixed dock. Fix: add className `whitespace-nowrap` to the tab label span or the entire button in BottomNav.jsx desktop branch (line ~61-72).
